chunks: 3316 - And al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who died and left behind a wife while she was pregnant. She gave birth to a boy after his death, then the boy died after he had fallen to the ground. The woman who received him testified concerning him that he cried out and screamed when he fell to the ground, then died afterward. He عليه السلام said: "It is upon the Imam to approve her testimony regarding one quarter of the boy's inheritance."

key_terms.حَامِلٌ: pregnant; describing the deceased man’s wife at the time of his death
key_terms.شَهَادَتَهَا: her testimony; the woman’s legal witness statement
key_terms.غُلَامًا: a baby boy born after the father’s death
key_terms.مِيرَاثِ: inheritance; the estate share under discussion
key_terms.ٱسْتَهَلَّ: gave a sign of life at birth by crying out
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامِ: the Imam; the authority who validates the testimony in this legal matter

ai.seo_question: When is a midwife’s testimony accepted in proving a newborn inherited before dying?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about inheritance when a posthumously born child briefly lives and then dies. It establishes that the testimony of the midwife may be accepted by the Imam to confirm signs of live birth, which affects the child’s share of inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3316 - And Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Umar ibn Yazid, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as), about a man who died and left behind a wife who was pregnant. She gave birth to a boy after his death, and then the boy died after falling to the ground. The woman who received him testified that he cried out and screamed when he fell to the ground, and then he died afterward.
Imam (as) said: It is upon the Imam to approve her testimony concerning a quarter of the boy's inheritance.
